items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: Well, that's the old man. Papa. That's what we call him.

ctx.x: We talked to one of the brothers of the old men. There was an old Lorenzo and a Louis Teo, Papa Teo.
Well, that's the old man. Papa. That's what we call him.
And there's now, there's still a Louis Teo living who was a brother of young Lorenzo, the very fine clarinetist.
